zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

checks.requirement: Raw intent must be separated from the example app so the factory does not overfit to todo/habits.
Meta-meta compiler must produce a product-tailored generated meta-skill contract.
Generated meta-skill must name surfaces, lifecycle mode, artifacts, tests, runtime gates, refusal rules, and human boundaries.
Dark-factory instantiation must create TASKS, TPM flow, PERT, knowledge graph, SDLC matrix, Hawkeye, and execution kernel records.
Code-producing work must not pass as documents only.
UI work must have browser/WYSIWYG evidence.
Scenario-driven work must have scenario, holdout, and transfer evidence.
Production gates are required only when production_surface is true; N/A decisions need rationale.
No material continuation after closure may occur without a new bead or change request.
Execution kernel must compute closed state after accepted work.
Hawkeye must audit every stage/process and hold veto power.
Claims must not use templates as proof.
checks.evidence: All controlling records set template_only false and validators reject template-only records.
